      <title>Koru UX Design LLP: Sr. UX Researcher (UXR-2-112026)</title>
      <region>Asia Only</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> India
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://jobs.workable.com/company/jozUZxNGqSdsinT91Ct4ET/jobs-at-koru-ux-design-llp">https://jobs.workable.com/company/jozUZxNGqSdsinT91Ct4ET/jobs-at-koru-ux-design-llp</a>
</p>

About the Company<p>Koru UX Design is a leading UX design agency specializing in HealthTech. We partner with clients to deliver user-centered design solutions that drive innovation and enhance user experiences. Our design teams work as an integrated extension of our client’s teams, deeply embedding ourselves into their processes to create seamless, impactful products.</p>About the Role<p>We’re looking for a Senior UX Researcher who thrives on complex problem spaces and is comfortable driving research in ambiguity. At Koru, your insights won’t just sit in reports—they’ll directly influence real enterprise products across healthcare, automation, and finance.</p><p>You’ll plan and execute end-to-end research studies, work closely with product owners, and help define experiences used by thousands of professionals in the US.</p><p>Location: Pune / Remote</p><p>Experience: 3–6 years</p><p>Type: Full-time</p><p></p>What You’ll Do<ul><li>Own and lead UX research activities across discovery, concept validation, and usability phases</li><li>Plan, conduct, and synthesise user interviews, usability testing, stakeholder interviews, and journey mapping</li><li>Create actionable outputs like personas, user journeys, service blueprints, and research reports</li><li>Proactively identify users to talk to—whether through clients, internal teams, or customer success</li><li>Translate research insights into product opportunities and design inputs</li><li>Collaborate with UX designers, product managers, and front-end teams throughout the design process</li><li>Help shape our research practice as we scale, including mentoring junior team members when needed</li><li>Proactively identify new opportunities for research&nbsp; within existing client engagements to extend project reach</li></ul><p></p><p></p>
What We’re Looking For<ul><li>3–6 years of hands-on UX research experience (not internships or academic)</li><li>Direct experience conducting research for enterprise or B2B products (SaaS, healthcare, platforms, or internal tools)</li><li>Comfort working with US-based users and stakeholders, and ability to adapt research communication accordingly</li><li>Strong system-level thinking: you can map workflows, identify gaps, and untangle complex journeys</li><li>Ability to handle open-ended, ambiguous briefs—you’re someone who finds ways to start and drive the process</li><li>Familiarity with creating journey maps, service blueprints, or ecosystem maps</li><li>Excellent verbal and written communication, with a knack for explaining research to cross-functional teams</li></ul><p></p>Bonus Points If You Have<ul><ul><li>Experience working in healthcare, automation, or other complex, high-stakes domains</li><li>Exposure to continuous discovery practices alongside product teams</li><li>Comfort engaging with product owners and client stakeholders to shape research direction and priorities</li></ul></ul>
<ul><li>Opportunities for growth and continuous learning (LinkedIn learning &amp; professional trainings).</li><li>Flexible working hours and remote options.</li><li>A collaborative and innovative team culture.</li><li>Opportunity for career growth and leadership roles.</li></ul><p></p><p>Koru UX Design is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/koru-ux-design-llp-sr-ux-researcher-uxr-2-112026">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/koru-ux-design-llp-sr-ux-researcher-uxr-2-112026</a></p>

      <title>MedAmerica: Instructional Designer</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>

      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Sacramento, California, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.vituity.com/about-us/practice-management">https://www.vituity.com/about-us/practice-management</a>
</p>

<p><span><strong>Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Instructional Designer</strong></span></p><p><span><strong>&nbsp;</strong></span></p><p><span><strong>Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare</strong></span></p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><span><strong>Join the Vituity Team.</strong></span> At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><span><strong>Vituity Locations:</strong> </span>Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><span><strong>The Opportunity</strong></span></p><ul><li>Designs and develops engaging, accessible, learner-centered learning solutions that support enterprise education, organizational initiatives, knowledge transfer, and performance.</li><li>Conducts learning and performance analyses to identify audience needs, desired performance, root causes, skill gaps, and appropriate learning or performance-support solutions.</li><li>Develops and customizes learning across modalities, including eLearning, instructor-led and virtual learning, blended programs, job aid, microlearning, simulations, assessments, video, communications, and other performance-support resources.</li><li>Translates complex content into clear, accurate, engaging, and learner-centered experiences through research and collaboration with SMEs and stakeholders.</li><li>Develops measurable learning objectives, instructional strategies, storyboards, scripts, prototypes, practice activities, assessments, and evaluation approaches aligned to intended performance outcomes.</li><li>Applies instructional design and adult-learning principles, learning science, usability, accessibility, content governance, brand/design standards; uses approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis, design, development, and quality assurance.</li><li>Conducts quality assurance and user testing to identify and resolve content, accessibility, usability, and functionality issues before implementation.</li><li>Creates and edits multimedia assets and refreshes, improves, or retires learning assets based on feedback, data, content changes, and business needs.</li><li>Shares design approaches, tools, lessons learned, and work in progress to support team learning and consistency.</li><li>Participates in peer reviews and provides timely, constructive, and actionable feedback; seeks and incorporates feedback on their own work.</li><li>Applies established instructional design standards and contributes recommendations to improve templates, guidance, workflows, and best practices.</li><li>Independently manages assigned learning projects, including scope, timelines, milestones, stakeholder reviews, approvals, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.</li><li>Balances multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality, responsiveness, and alignment with agreed-upon requirements.</li><li>Identifies opportunities to improve learning experiences, development processes, tools, templates, and team workflows.</li><li>Evaluates and uses approved learning technologies, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, efficiency, and learner experience.</li><li>Contributes instructional design and digital-content expertise to pilots, cross-functional projects, technology testing, and improvement initiatives within assigned scope.</li><li>Partners with SMEs and stakeholders to clarify performance needs, desired outcomes, audience requirements, and project expectations.</li><li>Recommends appropriate learning, performance support, or non-training solutions based on identified needs and constraints.</li><li>Provides guidance on learning strategy, modality selection, learner experience, accessibility, and implementation considerations.</li><li>Communicates recommendations, tradeoffs, progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.</li><li>Builds productive relationships with internal partners and represents Learning &amp; Development professionally.</li><li>May manage solely, or in partnership with the LMS Administrator, including but not limited to: uploading, testing, updating, maintaining, and retiring courses and curricula in accordance with established standards and processes.</li><li>Troubleshoots course-level Learning Management System (LMS) issues related to functionality, navigation, tracking, completion, and learner experience; supports testing of Learning Management System (LMS) updates and features and escalate system-level issues to the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator as appropriate.</li><li>Partners with the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator and stakeholders to support learner assignments and course delivery and develops or maintains SOPs and documentation related to instructional design processes and Learning Management System (LMS) interactions as needed.</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><span><strong>Required Experience and Competencies</strong></span></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, business, communications, or a related field required OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.</li><li>2+ years of experience in instructional design or learning content development, with related experience in areas such as technical writing/editing, digital content, multimedia development, or content governance required.</li><li>Experience applying one or more of the following: adult-learning theory, learning science, instructional design principles, and fit-for-purpose methodologies—such as ADDIE, SAM, and backward design—throughout the learning-development lifecycle required.</li><li>Experience conducting learning and performance needs analyses; defining measurable learning objectives; recommending appropriate learning or performance-support solutions; and evaluating learning effectiveness required.</li><li>Experience designing and developing engaging, accessible learning experiences across multiple modalities, including e-learning, instructor-led or virtual instructor-led training, job aids, performance-support resources, and interactive multimedia required.</li><li>Experience partnering with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to gather requirements, translate complex information into clear and actionable learning content, incorporate feedback, and move projects through review and approval required.</li><li>Experience managing learning projects from planning through implementation, including scope, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder communication, and competing priorities required.</li><li>Experience working with a Learning Management System (LMS), including uploading and managing content, supporting course assignments, tracking learner completion, and assisting with course administration required.</li><li>Proficient in Articulate 360, including Storyline and Rise, with the ability to develop, update, test, and troubleshoot interactive digital learning content required.</li><li>Working knowledge of – and ability to apply – accessible and inclusive learning-design principles and applicable standards, including captions, alternative text, color contrast, keyboard accessibility, and accessible documents required.</li><li>Experience applying WCAG and accessibility standards to e-learning and digital learning content preferred.</li><li>Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable digital-media editing tools preferred.</li><li>Experience using learning analytics, learner feedback, assessment data, or performance data to improve learning solutions</li><li>Experience with learning platform reporting, course lifecycle management, or LMS quality assurance preferred.</li><li>Portfolio demonstrates learner-centered, accessible learning solutions across more than one modality preferred.</li><li>Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design methodologies, learner-experience design, learning science, and performance-based learning.</li><li>Ability to analyze business, performance, and learning needs; identify root causes; determine when training is appropriate; and recommend practical learning or performance-support solutions.</li><li>Ability to translate complex, technical, or specialized information into clear, concise, engaging, and learner-centered content for varied audiences.</li><li>Ability to develop measurable learning objectives and align instructional strategies, content, practice, assessments, and evaluation methods with desired learning and performance outcomes.</li><li>Ability to design accessible and inclusive learning experiences by applying applicable accessibility standards and best practices across learning content and digital media.</li><li>Strong project-management and organizational skills, including managing multiple projects and priorities, establishing timelines, coordinating reviews, identifying risks and dependencies, communicating status, and meeting established deadlines.</li><li>Strong collaboration, consultation, and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members; facilitate productive discussions; incorporate feedback; and communicate recommendations clearly.</li><li>Proficiency with LMS, multimedia, collaboration, documentation, project-management, and productivity tools, including Microsoft 365 applications such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.</li><li>Ability to use learner feedback, assessment results, stakeholder input, and available learning and performance data to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve learning solutions.</li><li>Demonstrates the judgement, validation, confidentiality, and human-review practices required for responsible use.</li><li>Ability to work independently with initiative and sound judgment while contributing to a collaborative team environment through knowledge sharing, peer review, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement.</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><span><strong>The Community</strong></span></p><p>Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.</p><ul><li>Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more</li><li>Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth</li><li>Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations</li><li>Flexible work hours</li><li>Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><span><strong>Benefits &amp; Beyond*</strong></span></p><p>Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.</p><ul><li>Superior health plan options</li><li>Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&amp;D coverage, and more</li><li>Top Tier 401(k) retirement savings plans that offers a $1.20 match for every dollar up to 6%25 plus discretionary profit-sharing contributions (eligible January following 18 months of service)</li><li>Generous paid time off starting 3-4 weeks’ annually</li><li>Student Loan Refinancing Discounts</li><li>Professional and Career Development Program</li><li>EAP and travel assistance included</li><li>Wellness program</li><li>Purpose-driven culture focused on improving the lives of our patients, communities, and employees</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>We are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $64,970 - $81,215, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual corporate Success Sharing bonus program, which is based on the company’s annual performance. If you are hired at Vituity, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, and/or experience. We believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please speak with a recruiter for more details.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>We are unified around the common purpose of transforming healthcare to improve lives and we believe everyone has a role to play in that. When we work together across sites and specialties as an integrated healthcare team, we exceed the expectations of our patients and the hospitals and clinics we work in. If you are looking to make a difference, from clinical to corporate, Vituity is the place to do it. Come grow with us.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Vituity does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. Vituity is committed to complying with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>*Benefits for part-time and per diem vary. Please speak to a recruiter for more information.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><span><strong>Applicants only. No agencies please.</strong></span></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/medamerica-instructional-designer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/medamerica-instructional-designer</a></p>
</description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Pembroke Pines, Florida, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.elitebrain.ai">https://www.elitebrain.ai</a>
</p>

<div><p></p><h2>Company Description</h2></div><div><p>Our client is seeking photography professionals to support an initiative focused on evaluating and improving visual data quality for next-generation artificial intelligence systems. The project combines human creative expertise with detailed image assessment to help improve AI-generated visual content.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p></div><div><p></p><h2>Job Description</h2></div><div><p>We are seeking Photographers for a remote, contract opportunity supporting the evaluation and improvement of visual data used to train next-generation AI systems.</p><p>You will apply your photography expertise to compare original photographs with AI-generated images, identify visual inconsistencies, and provide detailed written feedback. No prior experience in AI is required.</p><p>Responsibilities:<br>
• Upload your own original photographic content through a secure digital platform.<br>
• Compare original photographs with AI-generated counterparts, identifying differences, visual flaws, and artifacts.<br>
• Evaluate lighting, composition, perspective, texture, and overall image quality.<br>
• Document findings using accurate technical vocabulary and clear, concise written English.<br>
• Participate in iterative review cycles and adjust feedback as project guidelines evolve.<br>
• Collaborate with the project team to clarify requirements and share observations.<br>
• Maintain current profile information to support project tracking and communication.</p><p>Location: Remote within the United States.<br>
Engagement: Independent contractor.<br>
Compensation: USD $21–$65 per hour.</p></div><div><p></p><h2>Qualifications</h2></div><div><p>• Demonstrated background in photography, digital imaging, photo editing, graphic design, or a related creative discipline.<br>
• Strong understanding of lighting, composition, perspective, texture, and image quality.<br>
• Exceptional attention to detail and a meticulous, methodical approach to image comparison.<br>
• Strong written English skills, including accurate spelling, grammar, and technical descriptions.<br>
• Ability to provide clear, concise feedback and adapt to evolving project guidelines.<br>
• Ability to upload original photographic content that you own.<br>
• Effective communication and collaboration skills.<br>
• Must be based in the United States.</p><p>Preferred:<br>
• Experience in image evaluation, image annotation, or quality assurance for digital or AI-related projects.</p><p>No prior experience in artificial intelligence is required.</p></div><div><p></p><h2>Additional Information</h2></div><div><p>• Work arrangement: Remote. Candidates must be based in the United States.<br>
• Engagement type: Independent contractor.<br>
• Compensation: USD $21–$65 per hour.<br>
• Project focus: Evaluation of original photographs and AI-generated images to support the improvement of AI systems.<br>
• Original content: Participants will upload their own original photographs through a secure digital platform.<br>
• Prior AI experience is not required.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elitebrain-photographer-ai-image-quality-evaluation-remote-u-s">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elitebrain-photographer-ai-image-quality-evaluation-remote-u-s</a></p>

      <title>Keeper Security: Creative Localization Specialist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Product Designer and Product Design</skills>
      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US
</p>

<p><strong>Description</strong></p>
<p>Keeper is hiring a detail-oriented Creative Localization Specialist to manage the localization of global creative assets across multiple languages and design platforms. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.</p>
<p>Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help deliver high-quality creative experiences to a global audience.</p>
<p><strong>About Keeper</strong></p>
<p>Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at<a href="http://keepersecurity.com"> KeeperSecurity.com</a>.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>As a Creative Localization Specialist, you will adapt existing creative assets into multiple languages and formats while ensuring accuracy, consistency, and adherence to Keeper’s brand and design standards. Reporting to the Director of Localization, you will work closely with the design team and Head of Product Design to manage localization workflows, resolve design challenges, and deliver polished assets across print, digital, and motion formats.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Localize creative assets in Adobe Creative Suite (primarily, but not limited to InDesign and AfterEffects), Figma, and motion graphics files for 16+ target languages</li>
<li>Manage design localization workflows by submitting translation requests through Smartling and applying completed translations to Figma and other design files</li>
<li>Adapt layouts, spacing, formatting, and visual elements to accommodate language-specific text expansion and contraction</li>
<li>Maintain consistency in terminology, brand guidelines, formatting, and design standards across localized assets</li>
<li>Conduct quality assurance reviews to confirm accuracy, formatting, visual integrity, and overall design quality</li>
<li>Support the localization of digital, print, presentation, video, and other creative materials</li>

<p>For most people, health insurance happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. <p>It's a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology. We're just getting started. We look for people who use good judgment, take ownership, and care deeply about building something that matters.</p>
<p>Design is central to what makes Thatch stand out. We're building a brand that sets a new standard for healthcare. We're a small, collaborative team with high standards for craft, bold creative thinking, and a shared ambition to make something complex feel remarkably simple.</p>
<p>We're looking for a <strong>Brand Designer</strong> to help shape Thatch's next chapter. We've built a product people love, and now we're ready to bring that same ambition to our visual identity. <p>Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.</p>

      <title>Cribl: Sr. UX Designer, Security</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>

      <skills>UI/UX, UX design, and Design</skills>

      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://cribl.io/">https://cribl.io/</a>
</p>

<div>
<p>Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.</p>
<p>We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.</p>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong>Why You’ll Love This Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows.</p>
<p>This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform.</p>
<p><strong><br>As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Lead end-to-end design from problem framing and research through interaction design, prototyping, validation, and implementation.</li>
<li>Design workflows for detection creation and management, alert review, investigation, triage, search pivots, threat coverage, normalization, and enrichment.</li>
<li>Apply security judgment to evidence, provenance, confidence, severity, permissions, auditability, destructive actions, and operational risk.</li>
<li>Design AI-assisted and agentic experiences that make intent, context, sources, capabilities, uncertainty, and user approval clear.</li>
<li>Use Cribl’s design system and contribute reusable components, patterns, guidance, and interaction models when the work has broader value.</li>
<li>Work expertly in Figma for exploration, prototyping, documentation, collaboration, and handoff, including libraries, variables, components, variants, and tokens.</li>
<li>Partner with engineers, PMs and designers through ideation, development to support feasibility, accessibility, resilience, and high-fidelity implementation challenges.</li>
<li>Share work early and often through critiques and working sessions. Give and receive specific, constructive feedback.</li>
<li>Use research and product evidence to prioritize opportunities, evaluate concepts, and improve shipped workflows.</li>
<li>Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners.</li>
<li>We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><br>If You’ve Got It - We Want It</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Required:</strong>
<ul>
<li>5+ years experience designing complex B2B software, enterprise platforms, or products for technical users.</li>
<li>A security background, such as security product design, security operations, threat detection, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC workflows, SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or a related discipline.</li>
<li>Understanding of security practitioners’ realities, including noisy signals, incomplete evidence, time pressure, and high-consequence decisions.</li>
<li>Strong product thinking and interaction-design skills, with the ability to make complex technical workflows simple without oversimplifying them.</li>
<li>Experience designing AI-assisted, agentic, conversational, or other emerging interaction models.</li>
<li>Expert Figma skills, including advanced prototyping and design documentation.</li>
<li>Demonstrated expertise working in and contributing to design systems. You know when to use existing patterns and when to extend them thoughtfully.</li>
<li>Understanding of AI tools and AI UX interaction models is required. You can design experiences where AI assists, recommends, generates, investigates, or takes action while preserving user understanding, control, and trust.</li>
<li>Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative and changing environment.</li>
<li>Strong communication, facilitation, and problem solving skills, including the ability to make progress when information is incomplete.</li>
<li>A portfolio with case studies that show your role, process, decisions, collaboration, and outcomes. Candidates will be asked to present and discuss previous work.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Highly desired</strong>:
<ul>
<li>Familiarity with research tools such as Dovetail, including transcripts, tagging, themes, repositories, and insights.</li>
<li>Experience with security data, detections, alerts, investigations, threat intelligence, telemetry, data pipelines, or analytical workflows.</li>
<li>Experience designing for roles, permissions, tenants, environments, or different levels of technical expertise.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>A plus</strong>
<ul>
<li>Understanding of accessible product design and inclusive interaction practices.</li>
<li>Familiarity with WCAG principles, keyboard interactions, focus management, semantic structure, color contrast, and accessible content patterns.</li>
<li>Familiarity with OCSF, MITRE ATT&amp;CK, KQL, Sigma, detection rules, threat intelligence, or related concepts.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
